notes.title: Bug Fixes and New Quests
notes.notes:
We’ve made some exciting improvements to enhance your experience!

🆕 Updated Game Icon – Enjoy our brand-new, refreshed icon!

🗺️ 15 New Daily Quests – Dive into fresh challenges and expand your adventure.

🧱 Object Placement Fixes – Fixed incorrectly placed objects for smoother gameplay.

🎮 New Objects Added – Decorate your walls with brand-new posters, add style and comfort with new chairs, and explore other fresh items to personalize your space.

Update now and experience the latest content firsthand!

notes.title: New objects and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Update Notes
[list]
[*] New chairs have been added.

[*] New tables have been added.

[*] Table grid cell alignment has been fixed, making it easier to place objects on tables.

[*] Scale adjustments have been made for some tables and chairs.

[*] Placement issues of certain auction items have been fixed.
 
[*] User-generated rooms are now available as template rooms.

[*] Some blurry textures have been improved for better performance on low-end PCs.

[*] Template rooms have been fixed (no more blank or yellow box images in the room tab).
[/list]

⚠️ Reminder:
Playing the demo may overwrite your main game save. Please avoid launching the demo if you want to keep your current rooms.

notes.title: Full Release Coming May 8, 2025 🎉
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

We’re beyond excited to finally announce that [b]Hotel Owner Simulator will officially launch in its full version on May 8, 2025![/b] 🎊 After a ton of feedback, polishing, and love from the community, we’re ready to open the doors wide and let you dive into the full hotel management experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158480/Hotel_Owner_Simulator/

If you've played the early version, you already know the basics - designing every room from scratch, adjusting layouts, placing walls, setting prices, and keeping those guests happy. But the full version takes it all further: more features, more freedom, and way more opportunities to grow your hotel empire one floor at a time. 🏗️

Whether you’re a perfectionist decorator, a business-minded negotiator, or just someone who loves watching a small idea turn into something huge - this is your time to shine.
We seriously can’t thank you enough for all the support, bug reports, ideas, and good vibes you’ve sent our way so far. ❤️

Let’s build, manage, and make something amazing.
[b]May 8th - mark your calendars.[/b] Your hotel empire is waiting. 🏨💼

notes.title: Hotel Owner Simulator Gardening Update
notes.notes:
Gardening Update. Trees, bushes, flowers – oh my! There’s a whole array of new gardening items to explore, along with revamped firepits to keep you cozy throughout the game.

Updates:
-Added Flowers.
-Added various plants.
-Added flower beds.
-Added trees.
-All trees, bushes, flowers, plants, rocks, and flower beds in the creative maps can now be moved or removed.
-Added fences.
-Hotel reputation is affected by garden decoration.

Fixes:
-Landscape is adjusted for easier gardening.
-Customer reviews are enhanced, they are more detailed.
